coverage_decision: All substantive guideline chapters, all 57 formal guidance statements, all 16 main tables, 14 main figures, 5 population algorithms, supplement Tables S1-S52, and PRISMA Figures S1-S4 were reconciled. References were extracted separately and not atomized.
omissions: Biographic/disclosure entries were inspected but not condensed person-by-person; conflict-management process is appraised at source level.

Individual rows of every SoF table are not reproduced in SEA HTML; each SoF table is inventoried and evidence families are synthesized, while the data supplement remains the authoritative detailed table source.
Bibliographic entries are not treated as evidence atoms; primary-study ATOM extraction requires the cited primary publications.
